_about: Public-domain Meister Eckhart (c.1260-1328, Dominican) in English for the Word Hoard: Meister Eckhart's Sermons, tr. Claud Field (Allenson, about 1909) from CCEL, and C. de B. Evans's translation of Pfeiffer's edition, vol. I (John M. Watkins, 1924) from an Internet Archive scan. Evans's vol. II (1931) is out of range. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 24 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
